description: This file manages outbound voice calls, including initiating calls, speaking messages, handling call continuation, and ending calls. It interacts with various call provider APIs and maintains call state and metadata.

methods.name: lookupConnectedCall
methods.description: Checks if a call with given ID is active, connected, or ended, returning its status and details.

methods.name: requireConnectedCall
methods.description: Ensures a call is active and connected, or returns an error.

methods.name: initiateCall
methods.description: Starts a new outbound call with specified parameters, handling call record creation and provider API interaction.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Plays a text-to-speech message on an active call.

methods.name: speakInitialMessage
methods.description: Speaks the initial message associated with a call, optionally hanging up after a delay in notify mode.

methods.name: continueCall
methods.description: Continues a call by playing a prompt and listening for a transcript, updating call metadata.

methods.name: endCall
methods.description: Terminates an active call with a specified reason.
